'''Pupaku''' was a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Xim Wars]].

==Biography==
Pupaku was recruited into the armies of the [[Hutt Empire]] and fought for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] during the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], against the forces of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. He survived the battle and recorded an account of his experiences during it, which he called ''[[The Third Battle]]''. In it, he included a number of tributes to the Klatooinians, [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], and [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]] whom he fought alongside during the battle.
